name: Comeback
blurb: Run deep, then turn back toward the quarterback.

name: Speed Out
blurb: A very short run, then a quick cut to the sideline.

name: Slant
blurb: Run about 3 yards (three steps), then cut to the inside.

name: Whip
blurb: Step inside to fake, then whip back out to the sideline.

name: Jerk
blurb: Step outside to fake, then jerk back inside.

name: Out
blurb: Run 10 to 12 yards, then cut to the sideline.

name: Dig
blurb: Run 12 yards, then cut flat across the middle.

name: Corner
blurb: Run 10 yards, then angle to the back corner.

name: Post
blurb: Run 10 yards, then angle toward the goalpost in the middle.

name: Fade/Go
blurb: Run straight down the field, drifting a little toward the sideline.
